rationale: With only 27 minutes to close, price is consolidating tightly near $239 in a narrow range (last 5 candles all within ~$0.37), sitting at 79.9% of today's range and above VWAP ($237.92) and 9-EMA ($238.85), suggesting mild bullish intraday momentum.
